job_description: Diverse Lynx is looking for UFT (Unified Functional Testing) Professional to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey Graphical User Interface (GUI) Testing: UFT allows testers to create and execute automated tests for applications with graphical user interfaces. It supports various technologies such as web, desktop, mobile, and composite applications. Keyword-Driven Testing: UFT offers a keyword-driven testing approach, allowing testers to create tests using a simple-to-understand set of keywords and actions. Scripting Support: UFT supports both VBScript and JavaScript for creating more complex test scenarios and custom functions. Integration: UFT integrates with various development and test management tools such as ALM (Application Lifecycle Management), Jenkins, and GIT, facilitating continuous integration and delivery processes. Cross-Browser Testing: UFT supports testing across different web browsers, ensuring the compatibility of applications across various environments. Data-Driven Testing: UFT allows testers to parameterize tests and perform data-driven testing by feeding different sets of test data to the same test script. Object Recognition: UFT employs sophisticated object recognition techniques to identify and interact with elements in the application under test, making test scripts more robust and adaptable to changes in the application's UI. Reporting and Analysis: UFT provides detailed test reports and analysis features to help testers and stakeholders understand the results of test executions and make informed decisions.

job_description: Department: Maintenance Reports To: Chief Engineer Role Summary The primary goal of an R&AC Technician is to keep people and products at the right temperature. Their work ranges from domestic refrigerators and split ACs to massive industrial cold storage units and central air conditioning plants (HVAC). They ensure that cooling systems run efficiently, safely, and without leaking harmful gases into the environment. Key Responsibilities An ITI R&AC Technician s duties are divided into installation, preventive maintenance, and emergency repairs: Installation: Setting up window ACs, split units, and commercial cooling plants. This includes copper pipe brazing, flaring, and connecting electrical power supplies. Gas Charging & Evacuation: Identifying refrigerant leaks, using vacuum pumps to clear the system, and refilling (charging) the unit with the correct refrigerant gas (e.g., R-32, R-410A). Electrical Troubleshooting: Testing motors, compressors, capacitors, and PCBs (Printed Circuit Boards) to find why a unit wont start or cool. Preventive Maintenance: Cleaning filters, descaling condenser coils, checking ampere loads, and lubricating motors to prevent breakdowns. Ducting & Insulation: For central plants, designing or repairing ducts to ensure even airflow throughout a building. Compliance: Recovering and recycling old refrigerants according to environmental laws to prevent ozone depletion. Shutterstock Explore Technical Skills & Toolkit Technical Expertise Essential Tools Brazing & Soldering: Joining copper tubes using gas torches. Manifold Gauge: To monitor high and low-side pressures of the gas. Circuit Knowledge: Understanding Star-Delta starters and inverter technology. Vacuum Pump: To remove moisture and air before gas charging. Leak Detection: Using soap bubbles or electronic leak detectors. Clamp Meter / Multimeter: To check current ( $A$ ) and voltage ( $V$ ).
